entries.title: The article column is narrower, and notes sit closer
entries.body: When the article has the page to itself, its column is a little narrower than before, so Marginalia notes sit nearer the paragraphs they belong to. Panels beside the article and the chat cards beside a passage get more room, starting at smaller window widths, which shows most on tablets and desktops.

entries.title: Endnotes in imported books no longer go missing
entries.body: In some books added as a PDF, a run of endnotes was left out, so the note numbers in the text linked to nothing, and a few notes showed only their number. Those notes are kept and linked. A book already in your library gets the fix the next time it is added again.
